verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe two takeover paths. You can take over a delegated task in Devin's IDE once it produces a first draft, and you can jump in through the Interactive Browser to guide browsing work. The terminal is documented only for watching commands and copying output, not for taking control, and /handoff moves work from the local CLI to cloud Devin rather than letting a developer take over. Missing for 10: documented hands-on terminal takeover of an in-progress session, explicit docs on redirecting a running task mid-flight, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the IDE and browser takeover flows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: Delegating a more complex task via the web application and taking over in Devin’s IDE once it gives you a good first draft.
You can jump in to help Devin navigate through browsing tasks via the Interactive Browser.
